integrity: Analytical proof accompanied by exact integer polynomial certificates and independent rational-matrix checks; no independent audit or mathematical certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Complete entrywise positivity-set classification is proved for uniform directed cycles with 2 through 6 states only; for orders at least 7 the exact intermediate-step set is not asserted. The six-state minimality is within the equal-rate one-way cycle family, not all Markov generators. Full novelty against unindexed literature is not assured.
title: A six-state threshold and positivity recovery for Radau IIA on directed cycles
